memberdef.name: correct

briefdescription.para: Compressible update: the density-weighted k and omega transport equations.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to OpenFOAM's compressible kOmegaSSTBase::correct() with alpha = 1: ddt(rho, psi) + div(phi, psi) - laplacian(rho*DpsiEff, psi) = rho*(sources) with the dilatation terms -SuSp((2/3) rho divU, k) and -SuSp((2/3) rho gamma divU, omega). divU is the divergence of the volumetric flux phi/interpolate(rho). nut stays kinematic.
The kinematic viscosity passed to the constructor must hold mu/rho at the current state; the caller refreshes it (in place) before every call.

briefdescription.para: Effective viscosity on faces: nu + nut (for momentum equation laplacian). After the compressible correct() it is the dynamic mu + rho*nut instead.
Effective k diffusion coefficient on faces: alphaK(F1)*nut + nu.
Effective omega diffusion coefficient on faces: alphaOmega(F1)*nut + nu.
Velocity gradient tensor (updated each correct() call).
Recompute gradUTmp_ in place at the given velocity (internal + boundary).
Returns the deviatoric stress at all boundary faces as Vector<SymmTensor>.

detaileddescription.para: Computes -nuEff * symm(twoSymm(gradU)).dev2() at each boundary face.

memberdef.name: gradScalar

briefdescription.para: grad of a scalar with the configured operator, or plain Gauss when none was set.
NeoFOAM-level wrapper for the k-omega SST turbulence model (Menter 1993/2003).

detaileddescription.para: Mirrors the OpenFOAM turbulence->validate() / turbulence->correct() interface. Owns all intermediate fields and cached operators. The solver manages the primary fields (k, omega, nut) and calls validate() once at setup and correct() after each momentum solve.

Coefficients follow the 2003 Menter/Kuntz/Langtry values (same as OpenFOAM default). Diffusion is written in terms of alpha = 1/sigma so that the inner/outer blending (F1) is applied uniformly — consistent with the OpenFOAM kOmegaSSTBase convention.
